summary.en: PCG requested drones and cybersecurity assistance from Australia and signed a maritime cooperation pact with Finland. PCG and a Japanese agency discussed further maritime safety cooperation. The Coast Guard and MGB‑7 tightened inspections of mineral shipments to Cebu and held an anti-trafficking session in Tuguegarao. President Marcos expressed optimism for improved relations with China after talks with Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Shenzhen. 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: PCG ba om droner og cybersikkerhetsbistand fra Australia og signerte en maritimt samarbeidsavtale med Finland. PCG og en japansk etat diskuterte videre maritimt sikkerhetssamarbeid. Kystvakten og MGB‑7 strammet inn inspeksjonene av mineralforsendelser til Cebu og holdt en antitrafikksesjon i Tuguegarao. President Marcos uttrykte optimisme for forbedrede forhold til Kina etter samtaler med utenriksminister Wang Yi i Shenzhen. 176 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
